children: From January 5 to November 6, 2026, Ferrari bought 2,166,855 common shares for €675.2M under its approximately €3.5B buyback program; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Shows substantial execution of the approximately €3.5B multi-year program; the release gives no prior-period comparison.
Held 2,056,475 shares in treasury as of Nov. 6
Treasury shares were 1.16% of issued common shares, or 0.88% of issued share capital including special voting shares.
The tranche is part of the approximately €3.5B program expected to be executed by 2030.

This is an execution update on Ferrari’s multi-year buyback program announced at its 2025 Capital Markets Day, rather than a new program authorization. Further purchases and cumulative spending relative to the approximately €3.5B target would show the pace of execution.
